verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a REST API (V3 PHP SDK, OAuth client) and an official MCP server exposing 145 tools with '11 financial reports' and full CRUD across 29 entities, implying reports access, but none of the evidence explicitly names General Ledger or Trial Balance endpoints or confirms open data formats (JSON/CSV) for these reports. Probes also found no discoverable OpenAPI/spec file, undermining the 'documented in open formats' claim. missing for 10: explicit documentation naming General Ledger and Trial Balance report endpoints, confirmation of output format (JSON/CSV), and a working OpenAPI/spec reference.
